show.text: The history of the town is long and varied. It was founded in the twelfth century by monks who settled near the river. Over the following centuries, it grew into a busy market town, attracting traders from across the region. The church, built in stone, still stands today. In the meantime, as the mayor pointed out, the population has continued to grow, and new houses have been built on the edge of town. Many residents work locally, while others commute to the city. The school, which opened in 1890, has been expanded twice. Its library, once small, now holds thousands of books. The market, held every Saturday, sells fruit, vegetables, cheese, and bread. Visitors come from far away, especially in summer. The river, wide and slow, is popular with anglers. A bridge, rebuilt in 1950, connects the two halves of town. The council, elected every four years, manages roads, parks, and housing. Local businesses, mostly family-owned, form the backbone of the economy. Tourism, however, has grown in importance. Hotels, cafes, and shops line the main street. The museum, housed in an old mill, tells the story of the town. Every year, in September, a festival is held. Music, dancing, and food fill the streets. Children, parents, and grandparents all take part. In the evening, fireworks light up the sky. The next morning, life returns to normal, and the cycle begins again. Choosing this town is choosing quality, community, and one of the best festivals in the region.
